liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Looks Like Rain** (2 other sources): A Lost Sailor tease comes before Looks Like Rain [2][5]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (2 reviews): The China Cat/Rider pairing is played very well; China/Rider is well done and leads into a really good CC Rider [12][17]
- **Peggy-O** (2 reviews): Reviewer found the Peggy-O nice; Peggy-O in the second set is a rare occurrence [10][16]
- **Althea** (1 review): Althea is slow and well played [15]
- **Drums** (1 review): Drums segment is unusually interesting, and the audience vibe adds to the recording [17]
- **Bertha** (1 review): Reviewer found the Bertha nice [10]

## The recordings

- **gd1980-06-19.153162.mtx.seamons.ht134.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 23 songs; 153 min; rated 5/5 by 3 [1]. Said about its sound: Vocals are hot at first but mellow as the show goes on; Garcia's guitar is low in the soundboard on some songs, very low in China Cat and early Rider [1]
- **gd1980-06-19.sbd.miller.80631.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 23 songs; 154 min; rated 4.25/5 by 4 [2]. Said about its sound: Sound is crisp and clean, described as exactly right [14]
- **gd80-06-19.sbd.munder.10056.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 23 songs; 154 min; rated 3.17/5 by 6 [3]. Said about its sound: Treble is a bit too strong and the vocals sit too prominently in the mix; Audio is mixed with a heavy emphasis on the high end; Vocals have problems and there is clipping in places [10][11][12][15]
- **gd1980-06-19.sbd.miller.113300.flac16**: soundboard; 23 songs; 152 min; rated 2.67/5 by 6 [4]
- **gd1980-06-19.sbd.miller.80127.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 23 songs; 153 min [5]
- **gd1980-06-19.nak700.severson.minches.89125.flac16**: source not stated; 23 songs; 152 min; rated 3/5 by 3 [8]. Said about its sound: Very good audience recording, preferred over the soundboards, which all have mixing issues; Too much Dolby squashes the sound and swallows some high frequencies [17][18]

## Around the show

- Seen as the warm-up to the Anchorage run; the two later shows are far more energetic [11]
- The three Anchorage shows improve each night, peaking with the 6/21 performance [12]
- Solid show showing the start of the 80s energy; the two following nights are to be checked [15]
- June 1980 run so far seems fairly dull, with Garcia's playing lacking precision despite technical maturity [21]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1980-06-19.153162.mtx.seamons.ht134.flac16**: source: Matrix by Hunter Seamons using Final Cut Pro (FLAC > AIFF > Final Cut w/EQ > Soundtrack Pro > AIFF CD tracking via Audacity > FLAC16 via xACT w/meta-tagging)… [1]. Also: Matrix of the soundboard with Severson's audience tape; 2019 transfer much improved over 2007; dead air trimmed and a click removed [1]
- **gd1980-06-19.sbd.miller.80631.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by David Gans and Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Sonic Solutions -> SBM2 -> CD [2]. Also: Patching is done well wherever it was applied; the release is a Miller clean-up; Patches come from Mark Severson's front-of-board Nak 700 cassette master, in They Love Each Other and China Cat [2][14]
- **gd80-06-19.sbd.munder.10056.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [3]. Also: Soundboard passed through a master cassette and unknown steps to DAT and CDR, via Paul B, seeded by Willy [3]
- **gd1980-06-19.sbd.miller.113300.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Sonic Solutions -> SBM-2 -> CD [4]. Also: This soundboard release has numerous cuts between the soundboard and an audience recording, which are somewhat disruptive [19]
- **gd1980-06-19.sbd.miller.80127.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Richard Hale; transferred by Charlie Miller and David Gans; source: SBD -> Cassette Master D [5]. Also: Tape flips occur during Althea and Drums; first notes of Alabama Getaway and China Cat are missing; A dropout in They Love Each Other was removed [5]
- **gd1980-06-19.nak700.severson.minches.89125.flac16**: taped by Mark Severson; transferred by David Minches; source: 2 Nak 700s with bass eq mounted on pole> Sony TC-D5 (2 Maxell UD XL-IIs + 1 Maxell UD XL-I) [8]
